description: Tropical cyclone hurricane/tropical-storm watch and warning coastline segments (NHC breakpoints) for Hurricane Melissa (AL132025), all advisories stacked (673 rows from 78 advisories; none were in effect for advisories 040 and 041). TCWW codes: HWR hurricane warning, HWA hurricane watch, TWR tropical storm warning, TWA tropical storm watch. Derived columns advisory_number, advisory_seq, issue_time (UTC).

table:columns.name: advisory_number
table:columns.description: Derived (CARTO): zero-padded advisory id, e.g. '003A'; join key across the forecast/* Collections.

table:columns.name: advisory_seq
table:columns.description: Derived (CARTO): 1-based issue order of the advisory (1..80).

table:columns.name: STORMNAME
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): storm name as written in the watch/warning file.

table:columns.name: STORMTYPE
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The category of the tropical cyclone according to the initial intensity' at issue (TS, HU).

table:columns.name: ADVDATE
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The date in which an advisory is issued'. Local-time text; parsed into issue_time.

table:columns.name: ADVISNUM
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): advisory number as NHC text, not zero-padded; use advisory_number.

table:columns.name: STORMNUM
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): sequential number of the cyclone in the basin (13 = Melissa, AL132025).

table:columns.name: FCSTPRD
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): forecast period in hours; always 120.

table:columns.name: BASIN
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The ocean where the tropical cyclone is located'; AL = Atlantic.

table:columns.name: TCWW
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'Code indicating the type of advisory and severity of conditions': HWR Hurricane Warning (294 rows, 50 advisories), HWA Hurricane Watch (149, 60), TWR Tropical Storm Warning (185, 55), TWA Tropical Storm Watch (45, 15).

table:columns.name: issue_time
table:columns.description: Derived (CARTO): advisory issue time in UTC parsed from ADVDATE (EDT and AST = UTC-4); 2025-10-21 15:00 to 2025-10-31 06:00 UTC.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Watch/warning coastline segment (LineString between NHC breakpoints; 76 single-breakpoint rows are Points) in lon/lat WGS 84 (typed OGC:CRS84 in the hosted file); extent -78.62, 17.70, -64.54, 32.43.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin DOUBLE, ymin DOUBLE, xmax DOUBLE, ymax DOUBLE)
table:columns.description: GeoParquet bounding-box covering column (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) written for predicate pushdown; not an NHC attribute.
